question: Among customers who paid in either CZK or EUR, compute the percentage of those in the 'SME' segment whose annual consumption in 2012 was below the overall average consumption of all such customers in that year. Also, return the difference between total CZK and EUR consumption for 2012.

prediction.sql:
WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        c.XCL_003 AS currency,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption_2012
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
      AND ym.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002, c.XCL_003
),
avg_consumption AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_consumption_2012) AS overall_avg
    FROM customer_consumption
),
sme_below_avg AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS sme_below_count
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    CROSS JOIN avg_consumption ac
    WHERE cc.segment = 'SME'
      AND cc.total_consumption_2012 < ac.overall_avg
),
sme_total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS sme_total_count
    FROM customer_consumption
    WHERE segment = 'SME'
),
currency_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN total_consumption_2012 ELSE 0 END) AS total_czk,
        SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN total_consumption_2012 ELSE 0 END) AS total_eur
    FROM customer_consumption
)
SELECT 
    CAST(sb.sme_below_count AS REAL) * 100 / st.sme_total_count AS percentage_sme_below_avg,
    ct.total_czk - ct.total_eur AS czk_eur_difference
FROM sme_below_avg sb
CROSS JOIN sme_total st
CROSS JOIN currency_totals ct

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        c.XCL_003 AS currency,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption_2012
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
      AND ym.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002, c.XCL_003
),
avg_consumption AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_consumption_2012) AS overall_avg
    FROM customer_consumption
),
sme_below_avg AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS sme_below_count
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    CROSS JOIN avg_consumption ac
    WHERE cc.segment = 'SME'
      AND cc.total_consumption_2012 < ac.overall_avg
),
sme_total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS sme_total_count
    FROM customer_consumption
    WHERE segment = 'SME'
),
currency_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN total_consumption_2012 ELSE 0 END) AS total_czk,
        SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN total_consumption_2012 ELSE 0 END) AS total_eur
    FROM customer_consumption
)
SELECT 
    CAST(sb.sme_below_count AS REAL) * 100 / st.sme_total_count AS percentage_sme_below_avg,
    ct.total_czk - ct.total_eur AS czk_eur_difference
FROM sme_below_avg sb
CROSS JOIN sme_total st
CROSS JOIN currency_totals ct

        t.XCL_011,
        t.XCL_012,
        t.XCL_013,
        t.XCL_018,
        c.XCL_002,
        c.XCL_003
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE t.XCL_012 IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2012'
),
customer_annual_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        XCL_013 AS customer_id,
        XCL_002,
        XCL_003,
        SUM(XCL_018) AS annual_consumption
    FROM filtered_transactions
    GROUP BY XCL_013, XCL_002, XCL_003
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(annual_consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM customer_annual_consumption
),
sme_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN annual_consumption < (SELECT avg_consumption FROM overall_avg) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sme_below_count,
        COUNT(*) AS sme_total_count
    FROM customer_annual_consumption
    WHERE XCL_003 = 'SME'
),
currency_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_012 = 'CZK' THEN XCL_018 ELSE 0 END) AS total_czk,
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_012 = 'EUR' THEN XCL_018 ELSE 0 END) AS total_eur
    FROM filtered_transactions
)
SELECT 
    (sme_below_count * 100.0 / sme_total_count) AS percentage_sme_below_avg,
    (total_czk - total_eur) AS difference_czk_eur
FROM sme_stats, currency_totals
